item.title: Nimbus Labs launches Nimbus 2.5 with a 1M-token context window
item.description: Nimbus Labs released Nimbus 2.5 on Friday. The new model has a 1M-token context window, and the company says it scores 71.2% on SWE-bench Verified. It is available in the API.

item.title: Introducing Nimbus 2.5, our most capable model
Nimbus Labs cuts API prices for Nimbus 2.5 by half
item.description: Nimbus Labs reduced pricing for Nimbus 2.5 API usage to $1 per million input tokens, half the previous price.
